purpose: v0.7.0: v0.6.2 kernel plus PMIC board temperatures and UFS MCQ; now the display link repairs, the IGCv5 degamma path, the SMP2P sleep state notifier, the wireless and Bluetooth corrections, the stylus, the pen dock charger, the camera flash and the fingerprint sensor
note: The kernel release fragments remain in the kernel source and are merged in order. tools/build-kernel.sh then applies kernel_release to CONFIG_LOCALVERSION for package ABI allocation without a kernel-only release commit; all other configuration remains unchanged. kernel/abi.json binds the final commit and .config. The pinned commit is on the contributor fork until the change is merged upstream; move the url and commit back to the upstream repository once it is.
